'''Kit''' (Japanese: '''りー''' ''Rī''), known as '''Tung''' in [[Chuang Yi]]'s translations, is a {{p|Lickilicky}} that {{adv|Diamond}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his fourth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. He is at [[level]] 53 and his [[Characteristic]] is that he is "often lost in thought."

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===
[[File:Kit battling Mars Yanmega.png|left|thumb|175px|Kit battling Mars's Yanmega]]
Kit first appeared as a Lickitung in ''[[PS390|Licking Lickitung]]'', having stolen {{adv|Diamond}}'s food and [[Town Map]]. Attempting to recover it, Diamond ran into the [[Pokétch Co. President]], who insisted he help advertise his [[Pokétch]]. While advertising, Lickitung showed up again in an attempt to grab more stuff, and Diamond decided to capture him. Lickitung attacked [[Don]] with {{m|Rollout}} and followed up with a {{m|Slam}}, allowing Don to throw Lickitung. This enraged Lickitung and caused him to [[Evolution|evolve]] into a Lickilicky. Diamond then attempted to capture him, but only ended up upsetting him more. Lickitung then burrowed underground and began attacking with {{m|Dig}}. Using his Pokétch Diamond figured out where Lickilicky's next spot to attack was and had {{adv|Lax}} grab him when he surfaced. Diamond then threw a {{i|Poké Ball}} at him, capturing him. Afterward, the two went around town and returned all of Kit's stolen items.

In ''[[PS393|Yikes, Yanmega!]]'', Diamond ran into a group of {{p|Yanmega}} being controlled by [[Mars]] that were attacking [[Roseanne]]. After assessing the situation, Diamond had Kit attack with {{m|Power Whip}} to scatter them and find the device that is controlling them. Diamond then had [[Tru]] attack with {{m|Razor Leaf}}, but the attack missed, surprising Diamond. Due to this, he and Kit go straight into the middle of the swarm and take one of their attacks head-on, allowing Kit to grab the device and smash it. Due to the device being destroyed, the Yanmega are left without instructions and leave.

In ''[[PS399|Mixing It Up with Machamp]]'', Kit was separated from Diamond, alongside Tru, at [[Lake Verity]] after falling from the Galactic airship. They were [[PS402|later]] taken to {{adv|Pearl}} by {{adv|Sebastian}}. In ''[[PS407|Chancing Upon Chingling]]'', once Diamond was spotted by the [[Advanced level Grunt]], [[Chatler]] returns Kit and Tru to Diamond. Kit then participated with Diamond's other Pokémon to battle against the Advanced level Grunt but proved to be no match for his strength.
[[File:Diamond and Kit.png|right|thumb|200px|Kit and Diamond]]
In ''[[PS416|Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia VI]]'', Kit was used alongside the other Pokémon to battle against the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Dialga}} and {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Palkia}}. With the help of Diamond and Pearl's Pokémon and with a combined technique, they were all able to destroy the [[Red Chain]]s controlling them.

==={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===
In ''[[PS430|Unplugging Rotom (Heat, Wash, Mow, Fan, Frost)]]'', Kit battled a wild {{TP|Diamond|Rotom}} that Diamond and Pearl were trying to protect. Diamond sent out Kit to battle against it and had him attacked with a Slam attack alongside {{p|Diglett|Digler}}'s {{m|Earthquake}}, but the moves dealt no damage due to it being an {{2t|Electric|Ghost}} type and having the [[Ability]] {{a|Levitate}}. Rotom then moved towards Diamond and Pearl and shocked them while giggling before leaving for [[Eterna City]].

In ''[[PS438|The Final Dimensional Duel VIII]]'', Kit helped alongside [[Cyrus]]'s {{p|Honchkrow}} to free Dialga and Palkia from {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Giratina}}'s trap. Kit used {{m|Me First}} to copy Honchkrow's {{m|Night Slash}} in order to cut away at their restraints.
{{-}}

==Personality and characteristics==
[[File:Kit Swinging Adventures.png|thumb|150px|Kit swinging across trees with his tongue]]
Kit is a mischievous and curious Pokémon who loves to play around. He has a habit of collecting items that he finds, even stealing them if they belong to someone prior to his capture. Kit is a powerful battler and can use his long tongue to deliver strong attacks and swing across trees with great speed. Kit is also easily enraged when losing a fight and will act out aggressively. He has a strong relationship with his {{pkmn|Trainer}} and shares his love of food.
{{-}}

==Trivia==
* Kit is the only Pokémon that Diamond has ever caught in a battle; {{adv|Lax}}, [[Tru]], [[Don]], and Moo were [[Gift Pokémon|given]] to him, and [[Reg]] and {{TP|Diamond|Rotom}} chose Diamond as their Trainer.
* Kit is the only Pokémon in [[Pokémon Adventures]] to have used the moves {{m|Power Whip}}, {{m|Wring Out}}, or {{m|Me First}}.
* Kit, as a Lickilicky, was the only one of its [[Pokémon (species)|species]] to appear in Pokémon Adventures.
